name: Pyramid hide
label: Hides
lead: Pyramid-shaped hide with Egyptian motifs in terracotta color - a themed shelter with a side entrance for a desert terrarium.

description.html: This hide is shaped like a pyramid in a warm terracotta color. The sides feature relief motifs, including an Egyptian-style figure and a fossil-like imprint, as well as carved bricks near the base. One side has an entrance into the dark interior.

The pyramid is a perfect piece for a themed desert terrarium: with light sand, rocks and dry plants you get a small Egyptian scene. Beyond its look, it works as a real shelter. The sloping walls meet at the top, so the interior is protected on all sides while your animal can see what is happening outside through the entrance.
It suits smaller lizards, geckos and other animals looking for a dark, enclosed hide.

Check that the entrance matches the size of your animal; it should pass through without trouble. The sloping walls do not offer a flat basking top, so the pyramid works better as a hide on the cooler side or as a second hide next to a cave with a platform on the warm side. Set it directly on the floor and fill the substrate around it. Clean the reliefs with a soft brush from time to time.
